scientific_integrity: Exact ellipse-chamber/Green-integral proof; finite hull-perimeter and polar-integral checks supplement rather than replace the proof. Unindexed equivalent historical computations remain a possible originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Proved for isotropic mean-width separation bodies of Euclidean equilateral triangles (all positive side lengths, all nonnegative parameters), not general polygons, anisotropic measures, or Poisson-cell expectation.
title: Exact area profile of the equilateral-triangle separation body
